from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information about a single provided paper extracted from one document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper described in this document")
    referenced_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """The parsed result for one document in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
